images.caption: Figure 3:The three environment types of AFK-Bench.Each row shows three of the 40 games of one type. Below each game are the real-time wins of VISTA and AutoPILOT out of three episodes with GPT-6.1 Sol.Tab.8lists all 120 games.

Figure 9:Case study: Radius Raid, a hostile real-time game, with GPT-6.1 Sol in real time. (a) VISTA at 6:42, shortly before its eighth failure. (b) An abridged version of AutoPILOT’s controller, which tracks the ship and enemies by color. (c) Best progress, model calls, steps and failures over game time. VISTA loses its progress at every failure, while AutoPILOT wins at 1:02.

Figure 10:Case study: Trichromat, a turn-based game, with GPT-6.1 Sol in real time. (a) VISTA moves once per model call and reaches the last room with its last calls. (b) AutoPILOT searches a Python model of each room and executes the solution with controllers, shown abridged for room 1. (c) Best progress, model calls, controller runs and steps over game time. Each room adds a third to progress.
